function.name: InteractionCounter_ConfigureActors
behavior: Divides PLAYER_INTERACTION_COUNTER by 10 and uses the quotient to select a root from the longword table at ROM 0x004A58.
When the quotient is nonzero, publishes that root to the slot-6 actor record, marks the record type as 0x84, and sets its Y field to 0x188.
Uses the remainder to select the slot-7 animation root and sets its Y field to 0x199.

conclusion: The interaction counter directly selects the animation roots for the two scene-rebuild interaction actors; it is not merely a scalar countdown.
